enum AcquireOutcome
  ACQUIRED = 'acquired'
  INSUFFICIENT = 'insufficient'
  HOLDERS_REFUSED = 'holders_refused'
  NOT_PERMITTED = 'not_permitted'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
dataclass AcquireResult
  outcome: AcquireOutcome | None
  lease: Lease | None
  asked: list[YieldRecord]
dataclass AnswerCallResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome | None
  answer: AnswerResult | None
dataclass AnswerResult
  recorded: bool
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
enum Evidence
  VERIFIED = 'verified'
  CLAIMED = 'claimed'
dataclass Holder
  program: str
  account: str
  amount: int
  evidence: Evidence | None
  lease: str
  grant: str
  since: str
  detail: str
dataclass HoldersResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome | None
  state: ResourceState | None
const KNOWN_RESOURCES
dataclass Lease
  id: str
  resource: str
  amount: int
  since: str
  renew_by: str
dataclass LeaseChange
  applied: bool
  lease: Lease | None
dataclass LeaseChangeResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome | None
  change: LeaseChange | None
class Leases
  acquire(resource: str, amount: int, wait_ms: int) -> AcquireResult
  renew(lease: str) -> LeaseChangeResult
  release(lease: str) -> LeaseChangeResult
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ObserveResult
  answer(request: str, answer: YieldAnswer | None, reason: str) -> AnswerCallResult
  bind_process(lease: str, pid: int) -> ProcessBindResult
class LeasesClient(Leases)
  __init__(transport)
  acquire(resource: str, amount: int, wait_ms: int) -> AcquireResult
  renew(lease: str) -> LeaseChangeResult
  release(lease: str) -> LeaseChangeResult
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ObserveResult
  answer(request: str, answer: YieldAnswer | None, reason: str) -> AnswerCallResult
  bind_process(lease: str, pid: int) -> ProcessBindResult
dataclass ObserveResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome | None
  page: YieldPage | None
enum ProcessBindOutcome
  BOUND = 'bound'
  UNVERIFIABLE = 'unverifiable'
  REFUSED = 'refused'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ProcessBindResult
  outcome: ProcessBindOutcome | None
const RESOURCE_ERROR_CODES
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
enum ResourceCallOutcome
  OK = 'ok'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
dataclass ResourceList
  resources: list[str]
  observed: str
dataclass ResourceState
  resource: str
  capacity: int
  held: int
  holders: list[Holder]
  observed: str
  instrument: str
dataclass ResourcesResult
  outcome: ResourceCallOutcome | None
  list: ResourceList | None
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'
  INTERNAL = 'internal'
  INVALID_REQUEST = 'invalid_request'
  CALLER_REFUSED = 'caller_refused'
  UNKNOWN_RESOURCE = 'unknown_resource'
  POLICY_UNAVAILABLE = 'policy_unavailable'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
class Table
  resources() -> ResourcesResult
  holders(resource: str, fresh: bool) -> HoldersResult
class TableClient(Table)
  __init__(transport)
  resources() -> ResourcesResult
  holders(resource: str, fresh: bool) -> HoldersResult
enum YieldAnswer
  YIELDED = 'yielded'
  REFUSED = 'refused'
dataclass YieldPage
  requests: list[YieldRequest]
  next: str
dataclass YieldRecord
  holder: str
  amount: int
  answer: str
  took_ms: int
dataclass YieldRequest
  id: str
  resource: str
  amount: int
  reason: str
  at: str
  lease: str
def decode(data)
def encode(v)
def service_name(frame)
